svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 03/12 The Sierra, Clear Day (Rare)
svg.desc: After a winter storm the air clears and the snowy Sierra lines up along the east. Look while it lasts. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
